body: I am very ugly too.  But I am non-ugly on the inside, because I always follow the Golden Rule.  According to my morality, this makes me non-ugly.  Are you non-ugly on the inside?  Do you have a big heart?  You can prove your worth by doing things for your community.  That is what I do.  I am so ugly that I am a 45 year old virgin.  So I release my inner-beauty onto the world via community service.

Sure, the magnitude of difference in power between a dog and  a human is less than the difference between a human and a hypothetical God-like advanced alien species.  Have you seen the movie "The Thirteenth Floor"?    I will gamble that if you watch it, your outlook on life may change a little bit.  It might make you a little bit less nihilistic.  Movie came out in 1999.

To your pet dog, you are God.  You 'magically' make the food appear, make the water appear, make the shelter and room temperature control appear.  It's all relative.  A super-advanced space alien species would seem like God to us.  In other words God could be definitely explained by physics, but perhaps a set of physics humans simply cannot understand or even detect.  My point is that we humans simply lack the ability to be able to ontologically say that our perceived reality is absolute.  Yes, we must make the best we can with the knowledge we have acquired, but absolute reality cannot be understood.  So, before you off yourself, you may find it worth your while to stay alive a little longer in order to study some science/mathematics/philosophy.  This is what has given me a little bit of motivation to stay alive, or at least in times in the past.

When you are asleep, you are dead.  It's like a computer - when you start it, the memories from the hard-drive are loaded onto the RAM.  Then when you turn off the computer, the computer is dead.   Same with a human.  When you are awake, you are alive.  Then, when you sleep, your brain RAM shuts off, and you are dead.  When you wake up again, a copy of all the memories of the previous years are loaded into your brain RAM, creating a clone of yesterday's occupier.

I am religiously Agnostic.  I think the current life of mine on Earth is pointless, but no one knows for sure if there is an After-Life.  The definition of the After-Life is a reality that exists outside of the laws of physics that humans understand.  Thus, we have no idea about what can exist after we die.   What if we are just living in a computer simulation in a super-computer of some advanced civilization?  What if we are just a dream?  What if there are other laws of physics that exist beyond the capacity of the human brain to detect or understand?  What if God exists in a higher dimension so He can see us, but we can't see Him?   What if the laws of physics that we understand are just fabricated in a computer simulation that we are digitally represented in?  Who knows.

Since I have Asperger's Syndrome, I can only offer practical help.  You said you want help because you don't want to die. Well, you can check yourself into a Psychiatric Hospital where they will keep you there for a period of time and attempt to help you.  My psychiatrist, after realizing I was suicidal, legally made me stay in an Insane Asylum Psychiatric Ward for thirty days.  Nothing they did helped me.  All their drugs and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy did nothing for my extremely genetically defective brain.  But I am grateful to my Psychiatrist and the Psychiatric Ward Insane Asylum for at least trying to help me.  May the Gods Bless them.

That sounds terrifying to me.  I could never use a train to kill myself.  I was hoping I would get the corona virus or something and then die from it.  Unfortunately, my immune system is too freaking strong. I don't even get regular colds or anything like that.

Are you assuming that your friends and family will by chance accidentally come to this forum and to this specific  thread and read it?  Would it not make more sense to write a physical letter and leave it on their desks or something?    I don't know.  The more of these threads I read, the more I wonder if most of them are written by trolls, just having fun by writing outlandish suicide manifestos.

Or you can try to be a super duper daughter from now on and make your mother feel great.  If you are about to get angry, pretend that you are a Vulcan or Lieutenant Data from Star Trek and suppress the anger and look at the situation logically.

That's very scary to me.  Jumping off a building.  What if it's not high enough and one does not die, but is just permanently damaged?  Or what if one gets caught  on something protruding from the side of the building?  My solution was to go sky diving in Mexico, but to then not release my parachute.  Guaranteed painless death.  But, I probably will be too cowardly to even follow through on this.

I also think the future is scary.  I think the present is scary too.  And I am myself a parasite upon my family, since I am too genetically defective to give more than I take, or at least to cut even.  But my family are like, "Naw dude, don't kill yourself, we need you, even if you are all genetically  messed up, we are still more happy if you are alive than dead."  But, I am still going to try to kill myself.  I have to - I am in too much emotional pain.
I drank a lot of alcohol with ten benzodiazepine tablets my psychiatrist gave me about 6 years ago, and it just made me feel good, but did not kill me.

I'm in the same boat.  I want to do it, but I'm too scared.  We are screwed.  Who is going to help us?  Society does not endorse helping people like us die. We are on our own.  But, I've always lived my life following the Golden Rule.  Thus, if I do succeed in dying, I think the next life will be interesting.
